text_en: Duke Wu of Zheng destroys Kuai.

经过: 郑武公灭东虢，以郐地为新郑。
text_en: Duke Wu of Zheng destroys East Guo and makes the land of Kuai into Xinzheng.

经过: 齐襄公伐纪，纪侯“大去其国”。
text_en: Duke Xiang of Qi attacks Ji, and the marquis of Ji "leaves his state for good".

经过: 楚文王灭申，置申县（一说前687）。
text_en: King Wen of Chu destroys Shen and makes it a county (one view: 687 BC).
Duke Huan of Qi destroys Tan, and the viscount of Tan flees to Ju.

经过: 北杏之会遂人不至，齐灭遂。
text_en: When the people of Sui stay away from the Assembly at Beixing, Qi destroys Sui.
King Wen of Chu destroys Xi and takes Xi Gui.

经过: 楚文王灭邓（同年曲沃武公灭翼，晋统于曲沃一系）。
text_en: King Wen of Chu destroys Deng (the same year Duke Wu of Quwo destroys Yi, and Jin is united under the Quwo line).

经过: 晋献公灭霍、魏、耿，以耿赐赵夙、魏赐毕万。
title_en: Fall of Huo, Old Wei and Geng
text_en: Duke Xian of Jin destroys Huo, Old Wei and Geng, granting Geng to Zhao Su and Old Wei to Bi Wan.

经过: 晋献公假道于虞，围上阳灭虢，回师袭灭虞。
text_en: Duke Xian of Jin borrows a road through Yu, besieges Shangyang and destroys Guo, then on the way back surprises and destroys Yu.

经过: 黄恃齐而不事楚，楚灭黄。
text_en: Huang relies on Qi and does not serve Chu, and Chu destroys Huang.
Duke Mu of Qin destroys Liang.
Duke Mu of Qin destroys Rui.
Duke Wen of Wey destroys Xing.

经过: 秦师袭郑不成，灭滑而还；滑地后入晋。
text_en: The Qin army fails in its surprise attack on Zheng, destroys Hua and turns back; the land of Hua later passes to Jin.
King Mu of Chu destroys Jiang.
Chu destroys Lu and Liao.
King Zhuang of Chu joins with Qin and Ba to destroy Yong.

经过: 晋荀林父灭潞氏；次年灭甲氏、留吁，前588 灭廧咎如，赤狄尽亡。
text_en: Xun Linfu of Jin destroys the Lu lineage; the next year Jin destroys the Jia lineage and Liuxu, and in 588 BC Qianggaoru, and the Red Di are wiped out.

经过: 齐灵公灭莱，迁莱于郳；同年莒灭鄫。
text_en: Duke Ling of Qi destroys Lai and moves Lai to Ni; the same year Ju destroys Zeng.

经过: 楚灭舒鸠，群舒尽入于楚（舒蓼前601、舒庸前574 已先亡）。
text_en: Chu destroys Shujiu, and all of the Qunshu pass to Chu (Shuliao in 601 BC and Shuyong in 574 BC had already fallen).

经过: 楚灵王灭陈，以为县；前529 平王复封。
title_en: Fall of Chen (made a Chu county)
text_en: King Ling of Chu destroys Chen and makes it a county; King Ping restores it in 529 BC.

经过: 楚灵王诱杀蔡灵侯，灭蔡为县；前529 复封。
title_en: Fall of Cai (made a Chu county)
text_en: King Ling of Chu lures Marquis Ling of Cai to his death and destroys Cai, making it a county; Cai is restored in 529 BC.
Jin destroys Fei of the White Di.

经过: 晋荀吴灭陆浑，陆浑子奔楚。
text_en: Xun Wu of Jin destroys Luhun, and the viscount of Luhun flees to Chu.
Xun Wu of Jin destroys Gu of the White Di.
Wu destroys Chao and Zhongli.

经过: 吴灭徐、钟吾，徐子章禹奔楚。
text_en: Wu destroys Xu and Zhongwu, and Zhangyu, viscount of Xu, flees to Chu.
Cai destroys Shen and kills Jia, viscount of Shen.
King Zhao of Chu, after recovering his state, destroys Tang.
Chu destroys Dun.
Chu destroys Hu and seizes Bao, viscount of Hu.
Duke Jing of Song destroys Cao and seizes Yang, earl of Cao.
King Hui of Chu kills Duke Min of Chen and destroys Chen.
